units.source_text: 这些来自筑紫的人预定宿山三天。

en.t: The people from Tsukushi planned to stay on the mountain for three days.

units.source_text: 右近本来不想久留，但念乘此机会可与乳母等从容谈话，便召唤寺僧过来，对他言明也要宿山。

en.t: Ukon had not meant to stay long, but thinking this would give her a chance to speak at leisure with the nurse and the others, she summoned a temple monk and told him that she too would stay on the mountain.

units.source_text: 供奉明灯的愿文中须填明施主祈愿。

en.t: In the prayer document for offering the votive lamps, the patron's wish had to be clearly written.

units.source_text: 琐屑之事，这里的寺僧都已熟悉，

en.t: The monks of this temple were already familiar with such minor details,

units.source_text: 右近只须言明大意：“依照向例，为藤原琉璃君供奉明灯。

en.t: so Ukon only had to state the general purpose: "As usual, we offer votive lamps for Lord Fujiwara Ruri.

units.source_text: 此外，此君现已觅得，改日当来还愿。”

en.t: Moreover, this person has now been found, and we will come another day to fulfill the vow."

units.source_text: 筑紫人闻知此事，皆深为感动。

en.t: When the people from Tsukushi heard this, they were all deeply moved.

units.source_text: 祈祷僧闻知此君现已觅得，得意扬扬地对右近说：“恭喜恭喜！

en.t: When the monk who had performed the prayers heard that this person had now been found, he said to Ukon with great satisfaction, "Congratulations, congratulations!

units.source_text: 此乃贫僧专诚祈祷之应验也。”

en.t: This is the answer to the prayers that this humble monk offered with single-minded devotion."

units.source_text: 信众大声诵经念佛，骚扰了一夜。

en.t: The believers loudly chanted sutras and invocations of the Buddha, making a disturbance all night.
